scripts.test: esbuild test/selftest.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=es2020 --outfile=test/selftest.cjs --log-level=warning && node test/selftest.cjs && rm test/selftest.cjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/tracetime && cp build/main.js build/manifest.json build/styles.css dist/tracetime/ && cd dist && zip -r tracetime-$(node -p "require('../package.json').version").zip tracetime
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
